---
title: WooCommerce
description: Privacy rules for WooCommerce 8.2 to 11.3 with HPOS on WordPress, on MySQL and MariaDB
---

Covers WordPress users and comments, and WooCommerce customers, HPOS orders and addresses, download logs, stock notifications, API keys, webhooks, and payment tokens.

## Coverage

- **Versions:** WooCommerce 8.2 to 11.3 with HPOS, on WordPress 6.4 to 7.1. Stores on post-based orders, or with compatibility mode on, keep order data in `postmeta`: keep the `mixed-content` rules.
- **Engines:** MySQL, MariaDB.
- **Table prefix:** the template assumes unprefixed table names. WordPress prefixes every table with `wp_` by default (`$table_prefix` in `wp-config.php`); prepend yours to every key.

## Template

```yaml
privacy:
  rules:
    emails:
      columns:
        - users.user_email
        - comments.comment_author_email
        - wc_orders.billing_email
        - wc_order_addresses.email
        - wc_customer_lookup.email
        - woocommerce_downloadable_product_permissions.user_email
        - wc_stock_notifications.user_email   # 10.2+
        - signups.user_email
        - registration_log.email
      entity: EMAIL_ADDRESS
      operator: hash
    names:
      columns:
        - users.user_login
        - users.user_nicename
        - users.display_name
        - comments.comment_author
        - wc_order_addresses.first_name
        - wc_order_addresses.last_name
        - wc_customer_lookup.username
        - wc_customer_lookup.first_name
        - wc_customer_lookup.last_name
        - signups.user_login
      entity: PERSON
      operator: hash
    phones:
      columns:
        - wc_order_addresses.phone
        - wc_customer_lookup.billing_phone   # 11.2+
        - wc_customer_lookup.shipping_phone   # 11.2+
      entity: PHONE_NUMBER
      operator: hash
    addresses:
      columns:
        - wc_order_addresses.address_1
        - wc_order_addresses.address_2
        - wc_order_addresses.city
        - wc_customer_lookup.city
      entity: LOCATION
      operator: hash
    postcodes:
      columns:
        - wc_order_addresses.postcode
        - wc_customer_lookup.postcode
      entity: POSTCODE
      operator: hash
    companies:
      columns:
        - wc_order_addresses.company
      entity: ORGANIZATION
      operator: hash
    urls:
      columns:
        - users.user_url
        - comments.comment_author_url
      entity: URL
      operator: replace
    ip-addresses:
      columns:
        - comments.comment_author_IP
        - wc_orders.ip_address
        - wc_download_log.user_ip_address
        - registration_log.IP
      entity: IP_ADDRESS
      operator: hash
    text:
      columns:
        - comments.comment_content
        - wc_orders.customer_note
      entity: PERSON
      operator: replace
    passwords:
      columns:
        - users.user_pass
      entity: PASSWORD_HASH
      operator: redact
    secrets:
      columns:
        - users.user_activation_key
        - signups.activation_key
        - posts.post_password
        - wc_order_operational_data.order_key
        - woocommerce_downloadable_product_permissions.order_key
        - woocommerce_api_keys.consumer_key
        - woocommerce_api_keys.consumer_secret
        - woocommerce_api_keys.truncated_key
        - woocommerce_payment_tokens.token
        - wc_webhooks.secret
      entity: API_KEY
      operator: redact
    # Optional: mixed-content columns. Ruling them hides their non-personal content too; remove to keep it readable.
    mixed-content:
      columns:
        - usermeta.meta_value
        - postmeta.meta_value
        - wc_orders_meta.meta_value
        - woocommerce_sessions.session_value
        - posts.post_excerpt
        - woocommerce_log.message
        - woocommerce_log.context
        - signups.meta
      entity: PERSON
      operator: replace
    # Keep: mixed-content columns that hold credentials.
    mixed-content-secrets:
      columns:
        - options.option_value
      entity: API_KEY
      operator: redact
```

**Choices**

- `comments.comment_content` holds product reviews and order notes (comment type `order_note`) too.
- `order_key` lets anyone holding it view and pay the order; legacy orders keep it in `posts.post_password`.
- `woocommerce_api_keys.consumer_key` (a hash of the key) and `truncated_key` (its last seven characters) are redacted with the secret.
- On multisite, network tables (`users`, `usermeta`, `signups`, `registration_log`, `blogs`) are shared, and each site N has its own tables under `<prefix><N>_` (e.g. `wp_2_wc_orders`): copy the site table keys once per site with that prefix.
- Optional parts: delete the `mixed-content` rule if the assistant needs those columns readable; keep `mixed-content-secrets`: `options.option_value` holds the SMTP password and extension secrets.

## Trade-offs

- **Indexed ruled columns:** `users.user_login`, `user_nicename`, `user_email`, `comments.comment_author_email`, `wc_orders.billing_email`, `wc_order_addresses.email`, `phone`, `wc_customer_lookup.email`, the `order_key` and `user_email` columns, `woocommerce_api_keys.consumer_key`, `consumer_secret`, the `signups` columns, `registration_log.IP`, and `wc_orders_meta.meta_value` (`mixed-content`).
- **Lookups that stop working:** customers or orders by e-mail, login, or IP; orders by order key; with `mixed-content`, every `meta_key = … AND meta_value = …` lookup.
- **Join keys that stay unruled:** `ID`/`id` and the `customer_id`, `order_id`, `user_id` columns, `meta_key`, and `woocommerce_sessions.session_key`.

## Not covered

- `wc_orders.user_agent`, `comments.comment_agent`: browser data, no matching data type.
- `wc_orders.transaction_id`, `payment_method`: payment references, not personal by themselves.
- `woocommerce_payment_tokenmeta.meta_value`: card type, last four digits, expiry; no partial-card entity.
- `woocommerce_order_itemmeta.meta_value`, `order_item_name`: product line data; add-on plugins store customer input there.
- `sitemeta`: network options, including the network admin e-mail and `site_admins` logins.
- Extension and Action Scheduler tables: not part of WooCommerce core.
